purpose: Source-level ledger of independent revenue engines; aggregate eligible net credited amounts into control/revenue_ledger.json without double counting.
rules: One source record per independent revenue engine or clearly defined source family; link product/platform and evidence.
Only actual independent-customer/provider transactions can contribute to PCNE.
Record gross receipts, platform/payment fees, refunds/reversals, direct runtime/delivery/support costs, restrictions/holds and net credited amount.
Aggregate eligible source-level net credited amounts into control/revenue_ledger.json exactly once.
A platform-to-bank withdrawal is a transfer, not new revenue.
A product-specific NO_GO does not set the parent source family to NO_GO without separate source-level evidence.
Do not add forecasts, GMV, downloads, free credits, grants or self-purchases to realized PCNE.
